Bill.BriefDescription: Clarifying the economic development powers of cities, towns, and counties.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to clarifying the economic development powers ofcities, towns, and counties; amending RCW 35.21.703 and 36.01.085;adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 36.01 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35.21.703 and 1985 c 92 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It ((shall be in the)) is a public purpose for all cities to, andall cities and towns are authorized to, engage in economic developmentprograms. To carry out the programs, any city or town is authorized totransfer or loan to any other city, town, county, or port district,with or without consideration, any funds, real or personal property,property interests, or services. In addition, cities and towns maycontract with ((nonprofit corporations)) public and private entities infurtherance of this and other acts relating to economic development.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.01.085 and 1985 c 92 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It ((shall be in the)) is a public purpose for all counties to, and p. 1 HB 1740all counties are authorized to, engage in economic developmentprograms. To carry out these programs, any county is authorized totransfer or loan to any other county, city, town, or port district,with or without consideration, any funds, real or personal property,property interests, or services. In addition, counties may contractwith ((nonprofit corporations)) public and private entities infurtherance of this and other acts relating to economic development.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any city or town may, upon the request of and pursuant to aninterlocal agreement with a port district, jointly exercise with thatport district any powers of the port district with respect to economicdevelopment programs or projects.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any county may, upon the request of and pursuant to an interlocalagreement with a port district, jointly exercise with that portdistrict any powers of the port district with respect to economicdevelopment programs or projects.

The powers granted by this act supplementthose previously authorized by law. Nothing in this act limits anyother authority of cities, towns, and counties. All prior actionsconsistent with the provisions of this act are validated.
